review_text: We ordered some iced coffee on a hot afternoon and it was good, but a tad too sweet than most. They have outdoor seating but we had to leave so we had it to-go. Some items are as pricey as most indoor coffee shops. But they do have affordable pastries and rice meals. Overall, it’s okay.

An outdoor cafe concept which is rare here in the Philippines. The ambiance is so good and so relaxing, you'll suddenly become kinda nature lover while sippin' your fave done coffee. 🤎🤍 So underrated! …

I’ve tried a lot of coffee around the Philippines and this just maybe the best so far. The ambiance here is very relaxing, It’s a simple cafe along the highway of Libby road, Bago Gallera. Walang maraming arte, it’s an open space (al fresco) with a big tree, tables and chairs and that’s it, pero ang sarap tumambay habang nagkakape while enjoying the fresh air and the beautiful scenery of the farm. Very charming barista!

The coffee was excellent, as usual, but the smoothies are far too sweet, and I can't taste the intended flavor. The one with coffee was overly caffeinated; balancing the sweetness and caffeine would be ideal.
The service is fast, and the drinks are TOP TIER, especially the cookies 🤤
